It has been remade twice since its addition to the game. ==Design & Path== {{Tabber |Current |The current version of '''Crossroads''' is a four quadrant map, with each quadrant being unique. The quadrant boundaries are path. Multiple sections of the path are blocked by brick walls. One quadrant consists of a plains. It has a few trees, bushes and rocks. A blue tower with yellow fences and stairs, and black columns can be seen. There is also a metal statue with a humanoid, which is simply standing and three grey spawn points.
The second quadrant is rocky, with yellow and brown hills. Multiple wooden crates and brick walls can be seen. There are also two grey spawn points, a grey sign and a metal statue with a humanoid, which holds a ball. There is a small hole caused by an explosion between the first and second quadrant, which has a bridge built above it.
The third quadrant is a barren wasteland, with brown rocks and multiple large towers, which appear to be candles. Multiple wooden crates, brick walls and three grey spawn points can also be seen. There is a metal statue with a humanoid there, which is dabbing.
The fourth and last quadrant is a black stone castle placed on dark brown mountains. Multiple large bones can be seen sticking out of the ground there. Two grey spawn points and a metal statue with a humanoid, which is wielding shurikens, can also be seen. The path starts at a cave and ends at another cave. The enemies will first go straight and then take two left turns, a right turn and two left turns. After this, they will go straight to the exit. |Version 2 |The second version of '''Crossroads''' is a four quadrant island map, with each quadrant being unique. The quadrant boundaries are normally the path and the ocean which surrounds the map. One quadrant contains grassy hills, while another is rocky with a stone bridge circling the perimeter, with a radio tower in the middle of the rotating path. Another quadrant is a barren wasteland, with brown rocks and a crumbling tower, while the last quadrant is a black stone castle. The path begins at a cave with the spawn symbol and head straight to the intersection where they go straight ahead. This path is initially bricked. They will then turn left onto a grass path. This rotates around a radio tower before intersecting with another bricked path. The path reaches the intersection again, and goes straight ahead, towards another cave with a spawn symbol. |Version 1 |The first version of '''Crossroads''' was originally an imitation of the classic Roblox game Crossroads, but much smaller. It had a classic battle arena feel to it, with a blocky design and blocky buildings. The white path began on a grey spawn and headed straight to the intersection where it turned left. The path then turned right onto a grass path. The path rotated around a tower before intersecting with the white path. Upon the intersection again, the path headed left towards the portal, where it ended. }} ==Interactive Map== {{Tabber |Current |{{Map:CrossroadsV3}} |Version 2 |{{Map:Crossroads}} }} ==Rewards== The game calculates how many {{Coins|Coins}}, {{Gem|Gems}} and {{Exp|}} you receive based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 50% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned is multiplied by 1.5x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplies any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. These two boosts are additive. Regular {{Exp|}} boosts are multiplicative with other modifiers present on this map. Any rewards that end in a decimal point is rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal. {{Rewards|Easy|Hardcore = Hide|Voidcore = Hide}} ==Strategy== *Since the path crosses twice in the middle of the map, it is suggested to place ground towers near it. **Melee towers and towers with short range, like the [[Assassin]] or [[Brawler]] excel at this spot **Towers that deals damage overtime such as the [[Pyromancer]] can be placed here as well, enabling them to deal the damage twice. ***Additionally, the [[Pyromancer]] can utilize its pierce to hit more enemies. *The path where the enemies spawn is long and narrow, making it a great spot for [[Archer]]s and [[Shotgunner]]s as they are able to hit more enemies with their piercing. *This map has a lot of cliff spots, making cliff towers very useful here. **Do note that some cliff spots may be far away from the path. You can use [[DJ Booth]] to increase the range of your towers. *Since the map goes around a loop, the [[Ace Pilot]] is able to cover most of the path when placed inside the loop. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} BlackFriday2023Thumbnail.png|Current version on the game thumbnail. BlackFridayThumbnailClean.png|Current version on a render. }} ==Trivia== *This map was originally based on the original ''Crossroads'' game by Roblox. *The trampoline that appeared in the first version of this map would launch players up into the air at high speeds when stepped on, in a similar fashion to the trampoline in the original ''Crossroads''. *This is the second map to have the path intersect without being a two-pathed map, with the other one being [[Rocket Arena]]. *In the original map, when enemies stepped off the spawn, they briefly went downhill. **Prior to the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]], this, [[Village of Despair]], [[Graveyard]] and [[Rocket Arena]] were the only maps in which enemies went at an incline. However, [[Village of Despair]] was the only one with a major incline. *Unlike many other maps that existed prior to the [[Release v1.0|MEGA Update]], this map was not remade or removed. **However, this map was remade in the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]]. *In the second version [[wp:Excalibur|excalibur sword]] could be seen in one of the corners of the map. *An image of YandereDev could have been seen in the cave on the side of the island in the second version. This was likely related to one of the creators of the map, DrinkTheMilkChalice, as their Roblox username was a phrase commonly associated with YandereDev. *Prior to the [[v1.0.0|Solar Eclipse Update]], on Hardcore [[Elevators]], the map creators were listed as ''"?"'' as if they were unknown. However, in regular [[Elevators]], the creators’ names were still credited. *Before the [[v1.6.0|Violent Night Update]], '''Crossroads''' had an {{Color|Easy}} difficulty rating in regular [[Elevators]] and a {{Color|Normal}} difficulty rating in Hardcore [[Elevators]], making it the only map in the game to have two difficulty ratings. *The multiple brick walls that appear on this map are a reference to the [[w:c:Roblox:Trowel|Trowel]], a weapon present in multiple BrickBattle games like ''Crossroads'' which built a brick wall. *One of the statues present on this map looks similar to the [[w:c:boss-fighting-stages-rebirth:Baller_(Class)|Baller]] class from ''Boss Fighting Stages Rebirth''. ==Update History== *'''5 August 2019''' - [[BETA v1.8|BETA v1.8.0]] **'''Crossroads''' added. *'''9 August 2019''' - [[BETA v1.9|BETA v1.9.0]] **[[Badges|Badge]] added. *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]] **'''Crossroads''' remade. **Made playable on [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode. **{{Color|Easy}} & {{Color|Normal}} difficulty added. **No longer gives a badge upon first triumph. **{{Bug}} Does not display its creators in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode [[Elevators]]. *'''4 December 2021''' - [[v1.0.0]] **{{Bugfix}} Now displays its creators in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode [[Elevators]]. *'''21 December 2022''' - [[v1.6.0]] **'''Crossroads''' remade. **[[Enemies Beta]] modifier added. **Difficulty changed from {{Color|Easy}} to {{Color|Normal}} in regular [[Elevators]]. *'''25 October 2024''' - [[v1.38.0]] **Difficulty changed from {{Color|Normal}} to {{Color|Easy}}. *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **[[Enemies Beta]] removed. **No longer playable in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode. ==Notes== {{MapNavBox}}
